purpose: Matched joint Hoeffding--CRC ablation (joint-H) vs Algorithm 1: same CP acceptance leg, MP utility leg, membership and argmax-U_LCB selection rules, and basic-tier failure allocations; only the U1 numerator bound family is swapped.

definition.numerator: one-sided range-Hoeffding UCB at the U1 allocation: r_H = B*sqrt(log(16m/delta)/(2 n_cert)); deliberately favourable to the baseline
definition.budget: same nominal failure budget delta; basic-tier allocations delta/(16m) numerator family, delta/(16m) Clopper-Pearson acceptance, delta/(2m) utility; union-bound failure at most 5*delta/8 for both
definition.claim_scope: basic returned-pair validity tier only; no inclusion or external-oracle guarantee is asserted for joint-H, regardless of (star) status
definition.aggregation: returned-pair statistics over feasible runs only; infeasible runs are never zero-imputed
